mods.name: mod-store
mods.description: An in-terminal app store: browse, search, install and update every Claude Mod from GitHub.

mods.name: secret-shield
mods.description: Blocks edits and writes that would commit API keys, tokens or private keys.

mods.name: env-guard
mods.description: Protects .env files, SSH keys and credential stores from being read or modified.

mods.name: rm-rf-guard
mods.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands like rm -rf /, mkfs, dd to disks and chmod -R 777.

mods.name: force-push-guard
mods.description: Forbids force-pushing to protected branches and suggests --force-with-lease.

mods.name: prod-guard
mods.description: Stops production-affecting commands (terraform apply, kubectl on prod, DROP TABLE) unless explicitly allowed.

mods.name: redactor
mods.description: Masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model ever reads them.

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Allows writes only inside the project root, resolving symlinks and .. tricks.

mods.name: curl-pipe-guard
mods.description: Blocks piping downloaded scripts straight into a shell.

mods.name: dependency-sentinel
mods.description: Flags typosquatted or brand-new packages before npm, pip or cargo installs them.

mods.name: lockfile-guard
mods.description: Prevents hand-editing lockfiles; they must change through the package manager.

mods.name: git-status-line
mods.description: Shows the current branch, ahead/behind and dirty file count in the status line.

mods.name: auto-checkpoint
mods.description: Snapshots your work tree before every editing turn and lets you /rollback to any checkpoint.

mods.name: commit-composer
mods.description: /commit writes a Conventional Commit message from your staged diff and commits it.

mods.name: branch-namer
mods.description: /git-branch creates a well-named git branch from a short task description.

mods.name: main-branch-warn
mods.description: Warns you the moment Claude starts editing files directly on main or master.

mods.name: diff-pane
mods.description: A live pane listing changed files with +/- line counts, updated after every edit.

mods.name: pr-describer
mods.description: /pr-desc drafts a pull request title and description from your branch diff.

mods.name: conflict-helper
mods.description: Detects merge-conflict markers and walks you through resolving each one.

mods.name: co-author-stamp
mods.description: Adds configurable Co-authored-by trailers to commits Claude makes.

mods.name: gitignore-guard
mods.description: Warns before node_modules, build output, OS junk or huge files get staged.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: Live session cost estimate in the status line, from real token usage.

mods.name: token-budget
mods.description: Set a token or dollar budget per session; get warned at 80% and stopped at 100%.

mods.name: context-gauge
mods.description: A slim band above the prompt showing how full the context window is.

mods.name: cache-hit-meter
mods.description: Shows what share of input tokens came from the prompt cache.

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: Times every turn and tells you when one runs long.

mods.name: big-read-guard
mods.description: Stops full reads of huge files and nudges toward offset/limit or grep.

mods.name: output-trimmer
mods.description: Trims huge command outputs to head, tail and error lines before they flood the context.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: Tracks spend per day and week across sessions with a /spend report.

mods.name: model-advisor
mods.description: Suggests a cheaper model when your prompt is simple, and a stronger one when it is hard.

mods.name: compact-coach
mods.description: Suggests /compact at natural breakpoints, before the context gets tight.

mods.name: quote-selection
mods.description: /quote pastes your mouse selection into the prompt as a Markdown quote.

mods.name: prompt-snippets
mods.description: Type :review:, :tests: or your own shortcodes and they expand into full prompts.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: A live pane of Claude's current task list with progress.

mods.name: focus-timer
mods.description: A Pomodoro timer in the status line with focus and break cycles.

mods.name: scratchpad
mods.description: A persistent per-project notes pane you can type into without leaving Claude Code.

mods.name: recent-files
mods.description: /recent lists the files read and edited in this session, newest first.

mods.name: copy-last
mods.description: /copy-last copies Claude's last answer (or its last code block) to the clipboard.

mods.name: prompt-history
mods.description: /history searches every prompt you have sent across sessions and reuses one.

mods.name: quick-commands
mods.description: Short aliases like /t, /l and /b that run your test, lint and build commands.

mods.name: idle-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you about uncommitted changes after a stretch of inactivity.

mods.name: auto-format
mods.description: Formats every file Claude edits with the right formatter for its language.

mods.name: lint-on-save
mods.description: Runs the linter on each edited file and hands the errors straight back to Claude.

mods.name: test-watch
mods.description: Runs the tests related to what changed and shows pass/fail in the status line.

mods.name: typecheck-gate
mods.description: Type-checks the project at the end of every editing turn so errors never slip by.

mods.name: no-skip-tests
mods.description: Blocks Claude from silencing tests with .skip, .only, xit or skip markers.

mods.name: todo-tracker
mods.description: Notices every TODO, FIXME and HACK Claude adds and lists them at turn end.

mods.name: debug-catcher
mods.description: Warns when console.log, print, debugger or dbg! statements are left in code.

mods.name: no-any
mods.description: Flags new any types, @ts-ignore and eslint-disable comments as Claude writes them.

mods.name: file-size-watch
mods.description: Warns when an edited file grows past a size that hurts readability.

mods.name: test-first
mods.description: A TDD mode: no production code changes until a test has been written or changed.

mods.name: tool-timeline
mods.description: A timeline pane of every tool call with duration, status and input summary.

mods.name: files-touched
mods.description: A pane of every file read, edited or created in the session, with counts.

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: /session-stats shows a dashboard of turns, tools, tokens, cost, duration and files.

mods.name: subagent-monitor
mods.description: Watch running subagents live: type, status, duration and last activity.

mods.name: error-feed
mods.description: Collects every failed command and tool error in one pane.

mods.name: activity-heatmap
mods.description: A heat map of when you use Claude Code, by hour and weekday.

mods.name: bash-history
mods.description: /bash-history lists recent shell commands Claude ran, with exit status and duration.

mods.name: web-trail
mods.description: /sources lists every page Claude fetched or searched this session.

mods.name: permission-log
mods.description: Keeps a log of every tool call that was denied, and why.

mods.name: token-sparkline
mods.description: A sparkline of tokens per turn right above the prompt.

mods.name: house-style
mods.description: Injects your team's style guide (STYLE.md) into the system prompt automatically.

mods.name: language-lock
mods.description: Makes Claude always answer in your language while keeping code in English.

mods.name: concise-mode
mods.description: /concise toggles short, to-the-point answers.

mods.name: prompt-enhancer
mods.description: /enhance rewrites your draft prompt into a precise, well-scoped request.

mods.name: ticket-linker
mods.description: Turns ticket references like ABC-123 or #42 into links and context for Claude.

mods.name: date-context
mods.description: Gives Claude the current date, time zone, branch and OS on every prompt.

mods.name: persona-switch
mods.description: /persona switches Claude between reviewer, architect, teacher and other roles.

mods.name: explain-level
mods.description: /eli5, /normal and /expert set how deep Claude's explanations go.

mods.name: stack-detector
mods.description: Detects your stack and gives Claude the right conventions for it.

mods.name: prompt-lint
mods.description: Gently flags vague prompts like 'fix it' and suggests what to add.

mods.name: done-chime
mods.description: Plays a chime when a long turn finishes.

mods.name: speak-summary
mods.description: Reads a one-line summary of what Claude did out loud when a turn ends.

mods.name: permission-ping
mods.description: Pings you with a sound and toast when Claude is waiting on your approval.

mods.name: error-buzz
mods.description: A short buzz when a command or test run fails.

mods.name: webhook-notify
mods.description: Posts to Slack, Discord, Teams or ntfy when a long task finishes.

mods.name: desktop-notify
mods.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude finishes or needs you.

mods.name: long-run-alert
mods.description: Alerts you when a single command has been running too long.

mods.name: ci-watch
mods.description: /ci-watch follows your GitHub Actions run and tells you the moment it passes or fails.

mods.name: break-reminder
mods.description: Reminds you to stand up and stretch every 50 minutes of active work.

mods.name: celebrate
mods.description: Celebrates when failing tests go green again.

mods.name: decision-log
mods.description: /decide records an Architecture Decision Record in docs/decisions.

mods.name: session-journal
mods.description: Writes a dated journal entry of what was done when the session ends.

mods.name: glossary
mods.description: Teaches Claude your project's vocabulary and injects definitions when you use the terms.

mods.name: bookmark
mods.description: /bookmark saves the last answer; /bookmarks lists and reuses them.

mods.name: resume-brief
mods.description: Shows what you were working on last time when a new session starts.

mods.name: lessons-learned
mods.description: When Claude fixes a mistake, offers to save the lesson to CLAUDE.md.

mods.name: codebase-map
mods.description: /map builds a compact map of your repository and gives it to Claude.

mods.name: snippet-vault
mods.description: Save and reuse code snippets across projects with /save-snippet and /snippet.

mods.name: link-vault
mods.description: Collects every URL from the conversation into one list.

mods.name: recall
mods.description: Gives Claude a recall tool to search your saved notes, decisions and journal.

mods.name: changelog-keeper
mods.description: Keeps CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section up to date as you commit.

mods.name: readme-sync
mods.description: Warns when public APIs, CLI flags or env vars change but the docs do not.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: /standup summarises what you did yesterday, from git history, ready to paste.

mods.name: review-agent
mods.description: Adds a dedicated code-reviewer subagent and a /review command.

mods.name: license-header
mods.description: Adds your license header to every new source file Claude creates.

mods.name: issue-drafter
mods.description: /issue turns the current conversation into a well-structured GitHub issue.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: /handoff writes a handoff note so a teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.

mods.name: i18n-guard
mods.description: Flags hard-coded user-facing strings in UI components.

mods.name: migration-guard
mods.description: Prevents editing database migrations that already exist; write a new one instead.

mods.name: codeowners-hint
mods.description: Shows who owns a file (from CODEOWNERS) as Claude edits it.
